item.title: Get It Growing: Boxwood diseases call for different treatment
item.description: Photo by Olivia McClure/LSU AgCenter Boxwood dieback causes browning and death of foliage. Boxwoods are among the most common evergreen shrubs you’ll find in Louisiana landscapes, and that’s because these plants were once considered foolproof.

item.title: Jeremy Alford and David Jacobs: Lawmakers have hopes for more tax cuts
item.description: The House Appropriations Committee began holding budget hearings this week, and Chair Jack McFarland will be looking for cuts.

item.title: John K. Flores: The purple martins are back
item.description: The Review/John K. Flores These purple martins arrived at the end of February Purple martins make their summer home selection. A male and female purple martin guard the entrance of their summer residence. Purple martins check the available space in their summer home This past week, my wife and I were working in the garden when the cheery sounds of purple martins seemingly came out of nowhere. “They’re baaaccckkk!” I said to her.

item.title: UPDATED WITH STORY: Swamp tour business opens with dreams and hopes
item.description: Lt. Gov. Billy Nungesser makes "Captain Billy" and Tammy Gaston unofficial ambassadors for Louisiana on Friday.
